- (agent-platform, ui-react) [Wizard toast room, agents read e2e](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3188) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — In the new agent wizard, a notification toast no longer covers the step's last control, such as `More options`. `Retry` on the home's `Couldn't load your agents` now reads every source of your agents again.
